result.instructions: Tools for bookingkit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings do we have for next weekend, and how many guests in total?"; "Show open places per date for our sunset kayak tour in the next 14 days."; "List all cancelled orders from last month with the customer names.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes bookingkit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bookingkit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bookingkit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bookingkit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bookingkit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bookingkit_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List the vendors (bookingkit customers: tour, activity and attraction providers) the API client can access. A vendor client sees only its own vendor. bookingkit API: GET /v3/vendors.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for paging).

fields.description: Comma separated list of properties to return.

accept.description: Comma separated list of ids to return only.

tools.name: bookingkit_get_vendor
tools.title: Get a vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by id. bookingkit API: GET /v3/vendors/{id}.

tools.name: bookingkit_list_events
tools.title: List events (experiences)
tools.description: List events (the bookable experiences, tours and activities) with prices, durations and categories. Optionally limit to one vendor. bookingkit API: GET /v3/events or GET /v3/vendors/{vendor_id}/events.

vendor_id.description: Only events of this vendor id.

category.description: Only events in this category id (see bookingkit_list_categories).

available_from.description: Only events with at least one date on or after this time.

delta_since.description: Only events changed since this time.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for paging).

fields.description: Comma separated list of properties to return.

accept.description: Comma separated list of ids to return only.

tools.name: bookingkit_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one event (experience) by id: description, price categories, durations, booking rules. bookingkit API: GET /v3/events/{id}.

tools.name: bookingkit_list_event_dates
tools.title: List dates (availability)
tools.description: List bookable dates with free capacity. Give event_id for one event, else all events. Use available=true to see only dates with free places. bookingkit API: GET /v3/events/{id}/dates or GET /v3/dates.

event_id.description: Only dates of this event id.

start_date.description: Dates on or after this time.

end_date.description: Dates on or before this time.

available.description: true = only dates with at least one free place.

delta_since.description: Only dates changed since this time.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for paging).

fields.description: Comma separated list of properties to return.

tools.name: bookingkit_list_orders
tools.title: List orders (bookings)
tools.description: List orders (bookings) with customer, tickets and status. Filter by order date, event date, status or order code. Optionally limit to one vendor. bookingkit API: GET /v3/orders or GET /v3/vendors/{id}/orders.

vendor_id.description: Only orders of this vendor id.

start_date.description: Orders placed on or after this time.

end_date.description: Orders placed on or before this time.

start_event_date.description: Orders with a ticket for a date on or after this time.

end_event_date.description: Orders with a ticket for a date on or before this time.

accept_code.description: Comma separated order codes (booking reference codes).

delta_since.description: Only orders created or changed since this time.

order.description: Sort: date, name or vendor_id; prefix - for descending (e.g. -date).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for paging).

fields.description: Comma separated list of properties to return.

tools.name: bookingkit_list_categories
